verdict.rationale: cubic offers configurable event-driven behaviors tied to pull requests. It reviews new PRs automatically, and custom agents are user-defined review rules applied to every PR, configurable via cubic.yaml. Auto-approval follows your review policy, auto-fix fixes issues from every review, and auto-resolve closes threads once issues are fixed. However, these are fixed, PR-scoped toggles rather than a general rules engine where you choose the triggering events and the resulting actions. Missing for 10: arbitrary user-defined trigger→action rules, events beyond PRs, outbound webhooks or custom actions, independent hands-on corroboration.
